name: OpenStreetMap Overpass
description: Read OpenStreetMap points of interest and their mapped tags through Overpass. Find nearby restaurants with website, email, phone, cuisine, address, and opening-hours tags when contributors supplied them. OSM data can be incomplete or stale; verify contact details against the business website. Public Overpass is for modest, occasional queries, not bulk extraction.

credential_fields.name: contact_email
credential_fields.label: Operator contact email
credential_fields.description: A monitored contact email included in the User-Agent so public Overpass operators can identify the application. No API key is needed.

credential_fields.name: overpass_base_url
credential_fields.label: Overpass API base URL
credential_fields.description: Defaults to the public overpass-api.de service. Override with your own Overpass /api base URL if you need reliable or frequent queries.

tools.name: find_restaurants_nearby
tools.description: Find OSM restaurant nodes, ways and relations near a latitude/longitude. Returns contributor-supplied tags and a center point for ways/relations. Inspect tags.website, tags.contact:website, tags.email, tags.contact:email, tags.phone, tags.cuisine, tags.opening_hours and addr:* when present. Small areas only; do not sweep a city into tiles.

radius.description: Search radius in meters, up to 2 km on the public endpoint.

tools.name: query_overpass
tools.description: Run a small, read-only Overpass QL query. Set [out:json] and a bounded area and timeout in data. Query the public service sparingly and use an OSM extract or your own Overpass instance for systematic collection.
